title: Machine, Assemble, Repair: How We Build Atlas | Boston Dynamics
title_zh: 机器，组装，修复：我们如何打造 Atlas | Boston Dynamics
abstract:
From custom part to running robot, the Atlas shop floor is built on precision, rapid assembly, and real-time collaboration. By machining parts in-house and streamlining assembly and repair under one roof, we are driving the manufacturing velocity needed to turn complex designs into walking hardware at scale. Build the future with us and explore open roles at bostondynamics.com/careers/

#BostonDynamics
abstract_zh: 从定制零件到能跑能走的机器人，Atlas 的车间建立在精密、快速组装和实时协作之上。通过内部加工零件，并在同一屋檐下简化组装与维修，我们正在推动将复杂设计转化为可规模化行走硬件的制造速度。与我们共建未来，请访问 bostondynamics.com/careers/ 探索开放职位。#BostonDynamics
